question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dramatic**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a significant increase in tea imports into the Colonies.
 
• The word needed should highlight the notable or striking nature of the increase.
 
• "**Dramatic**" means sudden, noticeable, or significant, which matches the description of the increase in supply.
 
• Other options ("**dull**", "**understated**", "**mundane**") do not convey the sense of a sharp or significant rise as required by the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The volume of tea imports into the Colonies rose at a very fast rate in the four years following up to the Boston Tea Party. They went from 55 tonnes in 1770, which was close to the amount dumped in the harbour, to 370 tonnes the year the tea was dumped. This was an increase of almost seven times. The population of the Colonies was about 2 million people in 1770 and didn’t expand much in that four-year period. Basic economics tells us this **dramatic__** increase in supply without more customers meant the price of tea had to fall.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dull: Means uninteresting or lacking excitement, which is the opposite of what the passage describes.
 
• Understated: Means presented or expressed in a subtle and effective way, but not appropriate for a significant increase.
 
• Mundane: Means ordinary or unremarkable, which does not fit the context of a sharp rise in supply.
